No routing or resource limits changed; capability #169 and engine-change #165 remain pending.
Benchmark readiness remains false. Artifact/version coverage is incomplete, native references are unavailable and product quality is unmeasured.

## What next
Run the recovery order, then review its accepted commit independently if verification succeeds.
The next cold session should use bounded JSON summaries, inspect actual continuation state and avoid rebuilding the saved cases or trusting the stale #170 report as a file inventory.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
